# Backgammon.js source

Selected open-source source for integration into Al-Mohtarifeen / Al-Molook.

Source: https://github.com/quasoft/backgammonjs
License: MIT (verify and retain upstream LICENSE when importing source files).

Status: selected for first integration; source code is not yet copied into the application in this commit.

Notes: JavaScript multiplayer backgammon with client/server architecture and Socket.IO. Integration must adapt its UI/network layer to the application's existing game/session system rather than expose the upstream demo directly.
